name: BARBELL BENCH PRESS
description: A compound press that builds chest thickness, triceps, and pressing power from a stable bench.
instructions: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar and feet planted.
Unrack with locked elbows and lower the bar to mid-chest.
Press up in a slight arc until elbows lock without bouncing.
Keep shoulder blades pinched and a natural arch in the back.

name: PULL-UP
description: A bodyweight classic targeting lats, upper back, and biceps through vertical pulling.
instructions: Grip the overhead bar with overhand grip wider than shoulders.
Engage lats and drive elbows downward toward your ribs.
Pull until your chin clears the bar cleanly.
Lower under control back to a dead hang.

name: BACK SQUAT
description: The king of lower-body lifts, developing quadriceps, glutes, hamstrings, and core bracing.
instructions: Position bar across upper traps and unrack with a solid stance.
Brace core, push hips back, and bend knees simultaneously.
Descend until hip crease is below knee level.
Drive through midfoot and stand up explosively.

name: OVERHEAD PRESS
description: A pure test of vertical pressing strength building deltoids, triceps, and upper chest.
instructions: Rest the barbell across front delts with hands shoulder-width.
Tighten glutes and press bar vertically past your face.
Lock out overhead with head through the window.
Lower bar smoothly back to clavicle shelf.

name: DUMBBELL BICEP CURL
description: Isolates the biceps brachii and forearms to develop peak arm development.
instructions: Stand tall holding dumbbells at sides with palms forward.
Keep elbows pinned to ribs and curl weights upward.
Squeeze biceps firmly at top of motion.
Lower weights with controlled 2-second eccentric.

name: HOLLOW-BODY PLANK
description: A gymnastics-inspired static hold demanding isometric abdominal and serratus engagement.
instructions: Assume standard plank position resting on forearms.
Tuck pelvis under to flatten lower back completely.
Push shoulder blades apart actively toward the ceiling.
Breathe rhythmically while maintaining deep core tension.

name: CONVENTIONAL DEADLIFT
description: A heavy posterior chain builder engaging hamstrings, glutes, lats, and spine erectors.
instructions: Stand with shins an inch from the bar, feet hip-width.
Hinge at hips, grip bar firmly, and pull slack out.
Push the floor away through midfoot until hips lock.
Hinge back down with control keeping bar glued to legs.

name: PUSH-UP
description: The fundamental bodyweight push targeting chest, triceps, and anterior delts.
instructions: Hands positioned slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Maintain a straight line from heels through head.
Lower until chest hovers an inch above the deck.
Press through palms to full lockout.

name: WALKING LUNGE
description: Dynamic unilateral leg training emphasizing glutes, quads, and stability.
instructions: Take a long stride forward with front heel landing first.
Lower back knee toward the floor without striking it.
Push through front midfoot to stand directly into next stride.
Maintain upright torso throughout the set.

name: RUSSIAN TWIST
description: Rotational core exercise loading internal and external obliques under tension.
instructions: Sit on floor with knees bent and feet elevated.
Hold medicine ball at chest level leaning back 45 degrees.
Rotate torso from side to side, tapping ball lightly to floor.
Keep ribs anchored and hips stable.

name: INCLINE DUMBBELL PRESS
description: Emphasizes the clavicular head of the pectoralis major for upper chest fullness.
instructions: Set bench to 30-degree incline and sit with dumbbells on knees.
Kick weights to shoulder level and press upward.
Lower slowly until dumbbells align with upper chest.
Press up and inward without banging weights.

name: LATERAL RAISE
description: Direct lateral deltoid isolation that widens shoulders and enhances V-taper physique.
instructions: Hold light dumbbells at sides with slight elbow bend.
Raise arms out to sides until parallel to the floor.
Lead with elbows keeping pinkies slightly elevated.
Lower slowly under control without swinging hips.
